description: One pre-scripted in-battle character talk line: who speaks, which localized text and voice to present, an optional portrait override, and the pauses around playback.

Id.technical: FName primary key; the playback system passes this value to the widget's OpenTalk and later uses the owning set's Id when notifying the character manager that talk ended. The row struct declares it as Id while the exported assets spell it ID (case-insensitive match).

WaitTime.simple: Delay before the line is shown.
WaitTime.technical: Seconds; constructor default 0.0f. On entering state 2 the system copies it to a countdown Timer, decrements by DeltaTime, and advances when Timer <= 0.0f. A zero value therefore displays on the next tick.

Id_Character.simple: Character row whose story name is used as the speaker label.
Id_Character.technical: FName into CharacterDataTable; None leaves the lookup unset and the widget collapses the speaker name. The same value selects the voice slot: the first live character whose CharacterRow.Id matches gets its character index, otherwise slot 0 is used. The widget reads Character.Id_GlossaryText_StoryName, not a name stored on this row.

Id_CharacterVariation.simple: Variation used to find a fallback battle-talk portrait.
Id_CharacterVariation.technical: FName into CharacterVariationDataTable. Consulted only when BattleTalkImageFileName is None; the variation's Id_CharacterImage then selects a CharacterImage row whose BattleTalkImageFileName supplies the texture. None/missing rows leave the image collapsed; the story phase's texture preload follows the same join.

BattleTalkImageFileName.simple: Direct portrait texture name, overriding the variation-derived portrait.
BattleTalkImageFileName.technical: FName passed to FindDynamicLoadTexture. If non-None it is used verbatim and skips the CharacterVariation/CharacterImage join; if None the fallback above applies; if the fallback also yields no name the portrait is collapsed. The same name is collected by the story phase for preloading.

TextId.simple: Localized subtitle text ID displayed for the line.
TextId.technical: FName passed to SerifText->SetTextIdOnly; the widget does not resolve the string itself. Typing visibility is driven separately by TalkVisibleCharacters/IsTalkFinished rather than by this field.

Id_Voice.simple: Voice row ID played with the line.
Id_Voice.technical: FName passed to AGameSoundManager::PlayVoiceById together with the speaker's character index (0 when no match). The returned VoiceHandle is polled with IsVoicePlaying and stopped after the line; it is also stopped when the talk system is reset/closed.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named BattleTalkDataTable into AGameDataTableManager::BattleTalkDataTables (+0xB40) after all primary assets finish loading; row lookup walks tables in order and takes the first hit, with None IDs rejected.
Queueing is driven by BattleTalkSetDataTable.Id_BattleTalk; the set condition arrays decide when a set is queued, while this row controls only that individual line's presentation.
The sequential state machine adds a fixed 0.5 s minimum after opening and a fixed 1.5 s gap after the last line; these are code constants, not fields.
All C++ here is a reconstruction of the retail game (retail addresses are recorded in source comments). Content is partial, so no claim is made about every retail row or every Blueprint use.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded BattleTalkDataTable into the manager's BattleTalkDataTables array.
Requests the BattleTalkDataTable primary asset during initial loading.
Finds each talk row referenced by a queued set and appends it to the playback queue.
Playback state machine reads WaitTime, Id, Id_Character and Id_Voice.
Widget resolves the row to render the speaker, portrait and subtitle.
Story phase walks set-referenced talk rows to preload portraits.
